title: Shipshape Projects
summary: Folders, raw data kept untouched, relative paths, seeds, and renv to freeze package versions: the project around a reproducible report.
hints: Raw data are read, never edited: every change to them is code, so it can be checked and redone.
A path like `data/raw/survey.sav` works on any computer that has the project folder; `C:/Users/me/Desktop/survey.sav` works on one.
`renv::snapshot()` writes the exact package versions to `renv.lock`; `renv::restore()` installs them again elsewhere.

quiz.prompt: Your SPSS file has a typo in one participant's age. Where should the fix live?
choices: Edit the .sav file and save over it
In the cleaning code, e.g. `mutate(age = if_else(id == 17, 21, age))`, with a comment saying why
Fix the number in the results chapter by hand
quiz.explain: Raw data stay exactly as collected. A fix in code is recorded, can be reviewed, and is reapplied every time the report is rendered.

quiz.prompt: Which line will still work when your advisor runs the project on their computer?
quiz.explain: A path relative to the project folder works wherever the folder is. Absolute paths and `setwd()` tie the code to one machine; `file.choose()` needs someone to click.

quiz.code:
renv::init()      # once, in a new project
renv::snapshot()  # after installing or updating packages
renv::restore()   # on another computer, or years later
choices: Your data, so it can't change
The exact version of every package the project uses, in renv.lock
Your R code, as a backup
quiz.explain: Packages change: a function's default can differ between versions (effectsize 1.0 changed how Cramér's V is adjusted). `renv.lock` lets anyone reinstall exactly the versions your results came from.

quiz.prompt: A bootstrap CI changes a little every time you render the report. What fixes that?
choices: Running it until you like the result
quiz.explain: A seed makes random numbers repeatable, so the report gives the same numbers every time. Report the seed in your methods.

quiz.prompt: Which project layout keeps raw data, code and output apart?
quiz.code:
thesis/
  thesis.Rproj
  renv.lock
  data/raw/survey.sav
  data/clean/
  R/01-clean.R
  R/02-analyse.R
  chapter-4.qmd
  output/figures/
choices: Everything in one folder on the Desktop
A folder per SPSS output file
quiz.explain: Raw data in one place (read-only), code in numbered scripts, the report in a .qmd, and output that can be deleted and rebuilt. An RStudio/Positron project file sets the working folder for you.
